hooks.command: guard="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ponytail-branch-guard.sh"; if [ -x "$guard" ] && "$guard"; then command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ponytail-activate.js" || exit 0; else exit 0; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $guard = Join-Path $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT 'hooks\ponytail-branch-guard.ps1'; if ((Test-Path $guard) -and ((powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $guard; $LASTEXITCODE) -eq 0) -and (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { node "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\ponytail-activate.js" }

hooks.command: guard="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ponytail-branch-guard.sh"; if [ -x "$guard" ] && "$guard"; then command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ponytail-mode-tracker.js" || exit 0; else exit 0; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $guard = Join-Path $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT 'hooks\ponytail-branch-guard.ps1'; if ((Test-Path $guard) -and ((powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $guard; $LASTEXITCODE) -eq 0) -and (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { node "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\ponytail-mode-tracker.js" }
